# implement-spec ledger — P11.1 flock_portal

- spec: docs/tickets/P11.1__flock-portal.md
- base commit: b0b91da452a6b0f223e77f59731dbbd908aff944
- branch: devin/p11-1-flock-portal

## Requirements (in-scope deliverables)
1. flock_portal connector sourcing portal layer from aggregator CC BY-SA 4.0 API; CC BY-SA compartment, never merged into CC-BY graph (SIG-INGEST-035, SIG-LIC-004a)
2. No challenge-defeating code; honour challenge as refusal (SIG-INGEST-036/037/031)
3. Change detection keyed on upstream data_last_updated, not fetch time; no poll faster than upstream (SIG-INGEST-030c)
4. Historical back-fill from archived captures (SIG-INGEST-030b)
5. ai_training_permitted=false recorded + enforced (SIG-LIC-004b)
6. Portal-existence events: disappearance -> event + task; appeared / no known deployment (SIG-INGEST-035)
7. Snapshot diffing at extracted-field level -> per-field change events (via P08.2 SIG-RECON-045)
8. Portal sharing = configured access only, directional, blank cells negatives, single-snapshot valid_from_kind='unknown'; asymmetry via P08.2 §29.3 (SIG-ONTO-042/044, SIG-RECON-034/035/036/037)
9. SIG-INGEST-031 fallbacks implemented + retained: (a) records acquisition; (b) contributor captures; (c) partner archives

## Out of scope
- audit_structural (P11.2), UsageAggregate (P12.1), access-path closure/3-edge inference (P12.2),
  records-request generation itself (P10.3), any per-search/per-plate row.

## Design notes
- Template: connectors/atlas.py. Framework: connectors/stages.py, pipeline.py, net.py, disappearance.py.
- Compartment already declared: policy/data/licenses.toml [compartments.portal] CC-BY-SA-4.0.
- Source already seeded: sources.toml [sources.eyes_on_flock] CC-BY-SA-4.0, MIRROR, public_terms_only, ai_training omitted => False.
- Reconcilers owned by P08.2: reconcile/sharing.py (SharingObservation/reconcile_sharing), reconcile/snapshot_diff.py (Capture/diff_captures/diff_series). MUST NOT fork.
- Challenge handling: net.PoliteFetcher raises ChallengeEncountered on 401/403/429; pipeline records disappearance. Do NOT catch.
- API: GET /api/v1/data -> {summary, portals}; portal fields: data_retention, total_cameras, total_searches,
  vehicles_captured, hotlist_hits, hotlist_hit_rate, organizations_shared_with, organizations_received_from,
  prohibited_uses, public_search_audit, portal_url, slug, state, county, population, type, data_last_updated.
